set: GK Drill 4: Goa: current and static

sections.name: GK drill: Goa: current and static

questions.q: Goa's third district, notified on 31 December 2025, is named:
questions.why: Named after the Kushavati river.

questions.q: The headquarters of Kushavati district is at:
questions.why: Its talukas: Quepem, Sanguem, Dharbandora, Canacona.

questions.q: Which taluka is NOT part of Kushavati district?
questions.why: Salcete stays in South Goa.

questions.q: Under the Goa Ujjwala Yojana 2026, eligible households receive:
opts: three free LPG cylinders a year
₹3,000 a year through DBT for cooking fuel
questions.why: Launched on 5 September 2026.

questions.q: Goa's Budget 2026-27, presented on 6 March 2026, created a new department of:
questions.why: It also raised MBBS seats at GMC from 200 to 250.

questions.q: Which policy was set to be unveiled at the Goa AI Tech Conclave in October 2026?
questions.why: Under Goa AI Mission 2027.

questions.q: The month-long 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' in Goa ran from:
questions.why: It opened with 'Aashirwad Ka Diya'.

questions.q: Goa's 'Mhaje Ghar Yojana' (2025) gives:
opts: ownership rights to long-time occupants of homes
questions.why: Launched by Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

questions.q: Who is the Governor of Goa (appointed July 2025)?
questions.why: Pramod Sawant has been Chief Minister since 2019.

questions.q: Goa's liberation by the Indian armed forces on 19 December 1961 was called:
questions.why: Operation Polo was Hyderabad (1948).

questions.q: Goa Revolution Day (18 June) marks the 1946 protest at Margao led by:
questions.why: It launched the civil-liberties movement.

questions.q: The Goa Opinion Poll, in which Goans voted against merger with Maharashtra, was held on:
questions.why: Observed as Asmitai Dis (Identity Day).

questions.q: Goa became the 25th state of India on:
questions.why: Daman and Diu became a separate Union Territory at the same time.

questions.q: Konkani was added to the Eighth Schedule by the:
questions.why: Along with Manipuri and Nepali.

questions.q: Goa's first woman Chief Minister was:
questions.why: Daughter of Dayanand Bandodkar, the first CM.

questions.q: Which river has the largest basin in Goa?
questions.why: The Mandovi (Mhadei) enters Goa from Karnataka through Sattari taluka.

questions.q: Dr Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary in Goa is located on:
questions.why: A mangrove sanctuary on the Mandovi.

questions.q: Goa's largest wildlife sanctuary is:
questions.why: With Mollem National Park; Dudhsagar falls lie within it.

questions.q: The Basilica of Bom Jesus, which holds the relics of St Francis Xavier, was completed in:
questions.why: A UNESCO World Heritage site (Churches and Convents of Goa).

questions.q: The Tambdi Surla Mahadev temple was built in the period of the:
questions.why: Goa's oldest surviving temple, in basalt, Dharbandora taluka.

questions.q: The Safa Masjid at Ponda was built in 1560 by:
questions.why: One of the few surviving medieval mosques in Goa.

questions.q: The Pinto Revolt of 1787 in Goa was:
opts: a conspiracy of Goan priests against Portuguese rule
a peasant revolt against the Marathas
questions.why: Named after the Pinto family of Candolim.

questions.q: The 'Comunidade' system of Goa is a:
questions.why: Asked in the January 2026 Mamlatdar paper.

questions.q: Manohar International Airport at Mopa was inaugurated on:
questions.why: Named after former CM Manohar Parrikar.

questions.q: Goa's state animal is the:
questions.why: State bird: flame-throated bulbul.
